sections.content:
Population change in Gosport in 2032

The population in Gosport is projected to decrease from 82,277 people in 2022 to 80,533 people in 2032.

There are seven areas in England where the population is projected to decrease in this period.

The biggest factor in this population change is births and deaths, which will decrease the population by 2,612 people.

This is different to the majority of areas in England, where net internal migration is projected to be the biggest factor in population change.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Gosport
sections.subtitle: How the population is projected to change, by cause
sections.source: Subnational population projections for England from Office for National Statistics – Migration category variant
sections.note: The components of change do not always sum exactly to the total population change in an area. This is primarily due to the effect of constraining the final projections to the National Population Projections for England.

sections.content:
Population change is projected by looking at births and deaths (natural change) and people moving in and out of areas. In Gosport, our projections show that between 2022 and 2032:

  • More deaths than births mean that the population is projected to decrease by 2,612, with 6,972 births and 9,583 deaths in Gosport between 2022 and 2032. This means natural change would decrease the population in Gosport by 3.2%, compared with an increase of 0.2% in England.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other local authorities in England) is projected to increase the population by 1,154, with 37,922 people moving to the area and 36,768 people moving from the area between 2022 and 2032. This would increase the population in Gosport by 1.4%.
  • Net cross-border migration (between UK nations) is projected to reduce the population by 845, with 1,481 people moving to the area and 2,325 people moving from the area between 2022 and 2032. This would decrease the population in Gosport by 1.0%.
  • Net international migration is projected to increase the population by 594, with 2,271 people moving to the area and 1,677 people moving from the area between 2022 and 2032. This would increase the population in Gosport by 0.7%, compared with an increase of 6.5% in England.

sections.content:
Age profile in Gosport in 2032

The median age in Gosport is projected to rise from 43 years in 2022 to 46 years in 2032.

In England, the median age is projected to be 41 years in 2032.

In 2032, 26% of the population in Gosport are projected to be aged 65 years or over, up from 21% in 2022.

sections.title: The 50 to 59 age group are set to see the largest change in Gosport between 2022 and 2032
sections.subtitle: Percentages of population by 10 year age bands, 2022 and 2032
sections.source: Subnational population projections for England from Office for National Statistics – Migration category variant

sections.content:
Between 2022 and 2032, the share of the working age population (people aged 16 years to State Pension age) in Gosport is projected to stay the same, at around 60%.

The old age dependency ratio (the number of people of State Pension age for every 1,000 people of working age) is projected to rise from 336 to 402 over the same time period.

This is above average for England in 2032 (287 per 1,000). Nationally, a high old age dependency ratio means more older people are financially reliant on the working age population to pay for pensions.

How will the number of young people change in Gosport?

In 2032, 18% of people are projected to be aged 18 years and under, down from 21% in 2022.

This is below average for England in 2032 (20%).

Looking at the youngest age groups in Gosport between 2022 and 2032, we can see the share of:

  • Infants (aged 0 to 4 years) will fall from 5% to 4%
  • Primary school age children (aged 5 to 11 years) will fall from 8% to 6%
  • Secondary school age children and sixth-form age (aged 12 to 18 years) will stay around the same, at 6%
